# Story 014 frame time, first build: X Damage updates counted for 60 s on one pinned view

Builds: before = ee60523 (unity.yml run for story 013's frame tilt, the stock terrain shader); after = 938e312
(run 40475229958, the snow shader); afteroff = 938e312 with the four snow weights at 0. The glints were then
reworked (cadd45d); its own measurement is `2026-10-27-frame-times-cadd45d.md`.

Each run: the Linux player at 1280x720 on Xvfb with Mesa llvmpipe (4 CPU cores), the Feel Lab's gravity at 0.001 and
'Apply: restart at top', so every run and build draws the test slope's start view; --screenshot/--after keep the
player drawing in the background. One line per second: <seconds> <updates> <longest gap ms>. Mesa's HUD read 0.77
frames a second when this counter read 1.4 to 1.5, so a frame is about two updates.
